symptom: Switching projects while Codex is waiting on a Nomi spend elicitation clears the panel card and leaves the app-server JSON-RPC request unanswered, so the turn hangs until interrupt/restart.
direct_cause: The panel effect on projectId set elicitation to null without respondElicitation; the host kept the request in pendingElicitations.
class_root: Pending server-initiated JSON-RPC requests were owned only by the visible React card, not by the host's project-scoped elicitation map.
affected_population: Users who switch projects while a director spend or action confirmation is on screen
Users who decline or complete a turn after a Codex panel spend accept that minted leftover renderer bridge tickets
entry_points: mcpServer/elicitation/request while a director turn is bound to a project
host.send() starting a turn for another project
preApproveNextAgentSpend after a panel spend accept
internal_only_reason: The elicitation is Nomi's own JSON-RPC form over the Codex app-server. No provider spend API is changed.
invariants: Every pending Nomi elicitation is declined or accepted through respondElicitation before it is dropped from UI or replaced by another project's turn.
Starting a turn for project B declines elicitations that are not for project B.
Renderer spend-bridge tickets are at most 1, scoped to the elicitation approvalScope, and expire on decline, project switch, and turn-complete.

recurrence.reason: Any project switch or new turn can drop the visible card while the same pendingElicitations map still holds the JSON-RPC id.
same_class_scan: Searched pendingElicitations, respondElicitation, setElicitation(null), and preApproveNextAgentSpend.
Host resetSession() already cleared the map on process exit but not on project switch.
Spend bridge copied nomiSpendApprovalPasses (20) independently of MCP session trust.

prevention.strategy: Host declines foreign elicitations when a new project turn starts; the panel declines the visible card on project change; bridge tickets are 1 and expire with the turn.

migration: No persisted data. In-flight hung turns still need interrupt/restart once; subsequent switches decline cleanly.
residual_risks: An elicitation that arrives with no projectId is declined on the next send() for any project, which is fail-closed.
A compromised renderer can no longer keep a 20-shot bridge window after one panel click; MCP session trust of 20 remains a separate host grant.
